descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S19 Scan time and which AI read the photo

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U10 Each scan records which AI model read the photo, and logs the AI call time separately from the total (3.9, 3.5). (UAT 3.9; UAT 3.5)
  • T3 Photo and census scanning runs on Google Gemini Flash via Vertex AI. (TFA-94425 AC 1)

Test design technique: Performance (performance) — Measure the time and check it is within the required seconds.

Given The 10 photos of S06 (5 Hospital + 5 Nursing Home)

When Each is scanned once through scanCensusSheet

Then Every call leaves an aiCallLog row with the model, durationMs and providerMs. The recorded model is a Gemini Flash model on Vertex, not a placeholder. Calls over 30 s are listed for review

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Per call, record the aiCallLog row (model, durationMs, providerMs), the ai_disclosure audit row's disclosed_to, and aiProvider:_current visionProvider / visionModel (read only). If model == 'vertex-configured-model', that is a U10 Fail ('model not recorded'): lib/phi.ts writes that literal when the aiProvider row has no visionModel. …

Where it ran: dev; test method PERF · Performance timing; lane planned in the matrix: AI check (automated)

S19 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-02.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: PERF · Performance timing; secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
